sources.description: SillyTavern导出的Infinite Stratos RP世界书。包含大量写卡/模式提示、AU化世界设定、剧情大纲、学园细节与初始关系网。
sources.notes: 原文件标题写作‘无限斯特托拉斯’，应为‘无限斯特拉托斯’。源内含大量模板、NSFW/写作流程提示和空白Part条目；curation仅抽取可用于世界设定、角色关系、地点、技术与剧情钩子的内容。

sources.description: User-saved view-source MHTML pages from Linovelib/Bili light novel for IS official volumes 11 and 12. Parsed locally into curated stories/vol-11 and stories/vol-12.
sources.notes: Used because direct site access returns Cloudflare/403 or browser timeout in agent environment. Raw MHTML copies are stored under raw-mhtml; manifest records URL/title/file/chars.

sources.description: Earlier Wenku8 scrape for IS. User corrected that BD3特典 and a short-story group had been counted as volumes, so the scrape only covered 10 main volumes plus supplemental groups.
sources.notes: stories/index.json now maps old vol-11 group to正文第10卷, and moves BD3特典/短篇 to supplemental IDs. Official vol-11/12 are from linovelib local MHTML.

conflicts.description: 源世界观将主舞台命名为‘青羽学园/Aethelgard Academy’并提到‘浮空都市艾茵多克’，这不是《Infinite Stratos》通常作品常识中的标准名称。
conflicts.resolution: baseline curated默认采用‘IS学园’；‘青羽学园/艾茵多克’作为源内AU别名或可选沙盒变体记录，标注evidenceLevel C或notes。

conflicts.description: 源中‘端白星AI’、好感度数值、地下设施细节、部分待机饰品等含明显RP扩展或未能从常识直接确认的设定。
conflicts.resolution: 作为可选RP机制保留，标注B/C，不覆盖核心作品事实。
